## Design tokens (from screenshot analysis)

- Full-screen fashion photograph background (light gray tones)
- Large bold uppercase white heading: "WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING FOR?"
- White rounded search input with placeholder "Type to search." + magnifying glass icon
- Category nav: white text links — "New Arrivals", "Ladies", "Mens", "Accessories" (active/bold), "Sale"
- No dark overlay — bright/clean aesthetic
- Font: Poppins (400, 600, 700)
- Colors: white primary, dark gray for active/hover states
